title: Notion Tools & Widgets
subtitle: Boost your Notion workspace with these free, embeddable widgets.
pomodoroDesc: Stay focused with this simple Pomodoro timer. It features work and break intervals.
lifeProgressDesc: Visualize how much of the day, month, and year has passed to stay motivated.
dailyQuranDesc: Get a new Quran verse every day with translation and beautiful typography.
ramadanPrayersDesc: Track prayer times and Ramadan countdown with this elegant, location-aware widget.
eventCountdownDesc: Luxury minimalist countdown for your most important life events.
habitTrackerDesc: Visual circular progress rings to track your daily routines in style.
assetTrackerDesc: Live price updates for Gold, Bitcoin, and Ethereum in one premium card.
weatherWidgetDesc: Minimalist weather widget with glassmorphism and real-time updates.
quoteDesc: Get a dose of inspiration with a new quote every time you load the page.
studyPlannerDesc: Organize your study sessions, track hours, and visualize your progress.
quranPlannerDesc: Generate a custom Quran reading plan based on your starting Surah and target completion days.
embedHint: Click to copy the embed link for your Notion workspace
ramadanHint: Note: Your settings will be saved in the link automatically
step2: Paste the link into your Notion page
noConfigHint: This widget works automatically with no extra configuration needed.
